errors.why: དྲན་བྱ belongs to the preceding line ('the earlier fault of the proof should be recalled here likewise'); the verse says the reason is not different from the probandum, not that 'the object to be remembered' and the probandum are identical.

errors.english: it is a single part of the ultimate truth

errors.english: the cognition that follows after a cow and so forth
errors.why: རྗེས་སུ་འཇུག་པའི་ཤེས་པ is the recurrent/common cognition (anuvṛtti-pratyaya) that ranges over all cows, the key term of the universals debate; it is rendered as temporal sequence here and as 'sequential cognitions' and 'applied consecutively' elsewhere.

fix.find: the cognition that follows after a cow and so forth
fix.replace: the recurrent cognition (anuvṛtti) regarding cows and so forth

errors.english: that some other cause exists after setting aside the universal
errors.why: སྤྱི་བརྩལ་ནས means 'in general, without specifying' (contrasted with ཁྱད་པར་སྒྲུབ་ན next); it has nothing to do with setting aside the universal.

fix.find: that some other cause exists after setting aside the universal
fix.replace: in general, without specifying it, that some other cause exists

errors.english: cognitions such as that of a "cooker" would be erroneous
errors.why: འཁྲུལ་པ here is logical deviance (vyabhicāra): the reason is inconclusive on account of the cognitions of 'cooker' etc., not that those cognitions are mistaken.
